decisions.executionNote: Begin left-side tube approach, lifting into elbow-up configuration and tilting toward a top grasp; geometry estimated from RGB.
Move above the leftmost tube, completing downward gripper approach with small continuous wrist rotation.
Lower open fingers around the leftmost tube while refining axis alignment; inspect before closing.
Close on the centered left tube and lift slightly to verify visual retention.
Tube appears retained; raise for clearance and begin rotating upright while moving toward the rack's left slots.
Continue upright rotation and transport above the left rack opening with tube held closed.
Finish upright orientation and align over the leftmost large front slot before insertion.
Lower the upright retained tube toward the left front opening; stop above final insertion height for visual alignment.
Slow final insertion of the first tube, maintaining upright orientation and checking for obstruction.
Tube appears to have met the rack rim rather than seated; lift and shift slightly toward the opening before retrying.
Refine alignment toward the visible large hole and gently lower for a second seating attempt.
Make a small lateral correction then open the fingers to let the tube settle into the left rack opening; verify seating from RGB.
Withdraw the open left gripper to inspect whether the released tube has settled upright in the rack.
The released tube has tipped rather than seated; move clear for an unobstructed view and recovery planning.
First tube is lying on the rack and will need recovery. Approach the remaining left-side tube with an open overhead grasp.
Continue rotating the left gripper downward above the second tube, retaining clearance from the rack.
Complete top-down alignment and descend open fingers around the second tube.
Shift the open grasp toward the tube's cylindrical middle, close, and lift a little to verify retention.
Lift the second tube clear of the loose tube and rack, then rotate toward upright while held closed.
Continue rotating the retained second tube upright and move above the rack's middle opening.
Finish upright alignment over a middle large opening and lower cautiously to inspect tip-to-hole registration.
Apply a millimeter-scale alignment correction and lower the second tube into the middle large hole, watching for slippage.
Continue the second tube's vertical insertion while preserving its stable grasp and alignment.
Release the second tube at insertion depth and begin a small open-gripper withdrawal to verify stable seating.
The middle tube now appears seated upright. Withdraw clear of it before recovering the loose tube in front of the rack.
Reorient the left gripper toward the loose tube's axis, approaching above it while staying clear of the seated tube.
Continue the overhead recovery approach, keeping the open fingers above the loose tube and away from the seated tube.
Finish the top-down recovery orientation and center above the loose tube for a controlled descent.
Descend around the recovered tube's upper cylindrical section, keeping the fingers open and axis aligned.
Close on the recovered tube after a small centering correction, then lift to check retention.
Recovered tube appears retained. Lift and move left/back for clearance while beginning its upright rotation.
Continue upright rotation of the recovered tube over the left rack slot, maintaining separation from the seated middle tube.
Complete the recovered tube's upright orientation above the left large slot before lowering for insertion.
Lower the recovered upright tube toward the left opening, watching for cap motion and rim contact.
Continue straight down to insertion depth with the recovered tube stable in the grasp; inspect before release.
Tube appears obstructed at the left hole rim. Unload slightly and shift toward the visible opening before another gentle descent.
The tip now appears better centered over the left hole; gently lower again and inspect actual tube movement before release.
The tube tip appears inside the opening but the low gripper is obstructed. Open and slightly unload the gripper, allowing the tube to settle while holding position.
Withdraw from the released left tube to verify seating while beginning an elbow-up approach to the remaining right-side tube.
Both released tubes appear seated. Retract the left arm toward origin while advancing the right arm above its tube in a continuous elbow-up approach.
Bring the right gripper into a downward approach above its tube while continuing the left arm's return toward home.
Finish the left arm's return and lower the right gripper around the last tube, adjusting toward its upper cylindrical section.
Close the right gripper on the centered final tube and lift vertically to verify secure retention.
The final tube is retained. Lift and move toward the rack's right side while beginning upright rotation.
Continue transporting the held final tube toward the right opening and rotating upright, with the left arm at home.
Complete the final tube's upright rotation and align above the rack's right large opening.
Lower the final tube toward the right slot with a small inward alignment correction; keep the grasp closed and inspect for rim contact.
Continue slow vertical insertion of the final tube; inspect whether it tracks downward without slipping at the rim.
The last tube appears to have met the rim and slid upward. Lift slightly to unload, then shift inward and back toward the visible opening before retrying.
The final tube tip appears centered over the right opening. Lower slowly again while checking for seating rather than further slippage.
